name: frontend-dev
description: Essential skills for frontend development: UI design, UX review, QA testing, browsing, and code review.
author: ASM

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Design and implement production-grade frontend components and UI pages

skills.name: dont-make-me-think
skills.description: Review UI usability using Steve Krug's principles and produce a scannable report. Use for UX audits of screenshots, URLs, or code. Don't use for brand critique, WCAG audits, or backend/API review.

skills.name: browser-qa
skills.description: Automate visual testing and UI interaction verification with browser automation

skills.name: e2e-testing
skills.description: Playwright E2E testing patterns, Page Object Model, and CI integration

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review code changes for bugs, security issues, and best practices
